text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original loop order, the `close < 0` skip (now an `if (close >= 0)`) and the same `Site` construction, so behaviour is unchanged, and the remaining method body is just two `if`s with the rest split into low-complexity helpers. One caveat: I can't see the declared types of `keyframes`, `guards` and `projectReset` in the unchanged part of the file, so the build rests on the new `IReadOnlyDictionary`/`IReadOnlySet` parameters matching what `InStyleSheet` and `Known` accept.
